text.p: West Coast, Eastern Eyre Peninsula and North West Pastoral districts.
The State Emergency Service advises that people should:
* Keep clear of fallen power lines.
* Beware of fallen trees or debris on the road.
* Don't drive, ride or walk through flood water.
* Keep clear of creeks and storm drains.

Check https://www.bom.gov.au/weather-and-climate/warnings-and-alerts. Warnings are also available through TV and Radio broadcasts or call 1300 659 210. The Bureau and State Emergency Service would appreciate warnings being broadcast regularly.

forecast-period.text: Storms continue through the North West Pastoral and inland Eyre Peninsula, but are no longer severe.

text.p: Weather Situation: Clusters of thunderstorms continue to move east through parts of the North West Pastoral and inland Eyre Peninsula this morning, but are no longer expected to produce heavy rainfall. Further severe thunderstorm development is possible later in the afternoon over a broader area of the state and new severe thunderstorm warnings may be issued if this occurs.
